text_ru: Товарищ председатель! Село пустеет. Если население окажется ниже порога ликвидации на двух годовых учётах подряд, колхоз ликвидируют и присоединят к соседнему хозяйству. Порог указан в годовой книге. Проверьте, хватает ли семьям жилья и продовольствия. Примите меры, пока колхоз можно сохранить.
meaning: The district warns that low population threatens the continued existence of the kolkhoz before liquidation has been decided
intent: Warn firmly and prompt the chairman to address household living conditions
keep: Two consecutive year-turn observations strictly below the liquidation threshold; no immediate decision or guaranteed grace period; no named official

meaning: The year book records population and the liquidation threshold after the early population warning becomes visible
intent: Show the count and its danger threshold in a plain ledger line
keep: Both integers supplied by the host; no fixed number or implication that equality triggers liquidation; no resident noun requiring plural forms
